name: special_hermite_polynomial_h
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::special_hermite_polynomial_h(Tensor x, Tensor n) -> Tensor. The correctness suite covers the canonically registered default and n_scalar overloads, integer tensor and Python scalar degrees in [0, 9], float32/float64 computation, and scalar/tensor out-of-range errors. The operation does not mutate or alias either input.
